fig_masking_policies.classification: Selected mask illustrations plus six empirical AUC annotations; epochs and image-selection indices are metadata.
fig_masking_policies.rationale: Actual OCR reads six AUC/epoch headings. All six displayed four-decimal AUCs agree with the retained original-precision inventory rows, but this does not verify the colored target masks, sampler provenance, selected volume, or seed. The whole asset is not nonquantitative.
fig_masking_policies.limitations: No historical mask coordinates, seed/selection receipt, or exact producer was recovered. OCR is fallible. AUC source agreement is an annotation check, not mathematical verification of the image grid. Unequal epochs cannot establish a policy comparison.
fig_masking_policies.unresolved_scientific_claim: Whether the displayed historical target masks were actually produced by the stated production samplers and faithfully instantiate the named policies.
fig_masking_policies.minimal_action: Prefer removing this redundant appendix grid and referring to the already independently reviewed delivered-mask figure. Alternatively retain only the existing mask-image panels without AUC annotations, explicitly label them selected historical illustrations with unrecovered draw provenance, and review the new exact asset/caption. Do not replace these fine-grained examples with invented masks or call the current whole asset illustrative-only.

fig_precision_paradox.classification: Quantitative AUC-versus-purity scatter with fitted and null-reference lines; not an illustration.
fig_precision_paradox.rationale: PDF vector tick labels and coordinates independently recover five data points; PNG spines and colored-marker centers agree with the PDF geometry. All five purity values fail the current Table2 geometry source even after one-decimal rounding tolerance. AUC coordinates agree with historical inventory values rounded to six decimals.
fig_precision_paradox.limitations: The historical AUC points mix fp16 rectangle-arm probes with fp32 shaped/coverage probes. The vector extraction verifies retained summary-to-mark agreement, not generation of raw masks or validity of the interpretation. Full raster numeric-label reading is not certified: some labels overlap.
fig_precision_paradox.unresolved_scientific_claim: The title's general statement that masking anatomy more accurately does not help, and any significance/non-separation claim inferred from a point plot with no intervals.
fig_precision_paradox.minimal_action: Parent may regenerate from the exact Table2 seed42 hidden_pct_on_anat fields and explicitly chosen matched-epoch, matched-precision AUC inventory rows. Use a descriptive title, exactly five arms, defined target-union purity, and clear no-retraining/no-causal-ranking limits. Otherwise remove the scatter and point readers to the verified geometry and performance tables.

interp_04_window_occlusion_W7.classification: Six quantitative class-mean attribution curves, sample counts, and an empirical sevenfold-amplification title.
interp_04_window_occlusion_W7.rationale: The actual image title says it amplifies single-slice signal 7x while smoothing noise. The asset equals the retained summary PNG, but no window_contrib arrays or independently extracted vector series were recovered. Window size seven is protocol; sevenfold gain is an empirical claim, not the same kind of number.
interp_04_window_occlusion_W7.limitations: Historical documentation asserts the same conclusion but is not independent numeric evidence. Even disclosure that arrays are unavailable does not verify displayed curves, means, counts, amplification, or noise reduction.
interp_04_window_occlusion_W7.unresolved_scientific_claim: Sevenfold amplification, systematic underestimation by single-slice occlusion, and improved signal/noise or completeness.
interp_04_window_occlusion_W7.minimal_action: Remove this figure and its empirical comparison unless original window/slice summary arrays can be retained and independently checked. A non-results method description may state that zeroing a contiguous window is a different perturbation; do not claim a recovered gain or smoothing effect.

interp_14_odos_mirror_test.classification: Six quantitative cluster-mean line panels with correlations and cluster sample counts.
interp_14_odos_mirror_test.rationale: Actual labels include mirrored correlations +0.971, +0.988 and +0.237, with distinct raw correlations and cluster sizes. The retained code describes L2 normalization, k-means with two clusters, and reversal of cluster-mean curves; arrays needed to validate those results are absent.
interp_14_odos_mirror_test.limitations: No ground-truth eye-laterality labels exist in the described evidence. Mirror similarity cannot establish actual OD/OS storage reversal; clustering and flipping are model-derived, not external validation. A historical PNG/code match cannot reproduce correlations.
interp_14_odos_mirror_test.unresolved_scientific_claim: Near-perfect mirror structure of two probes, the population-mixture explanation, and identification of that mixture as OD/OS.
interp_14_odos_mirror_test.minimal_action: Remove empirical OD/OS and mirror-clustering findings without retained attribution summaries. It is defensible to keep only a methodological caution that averaging over unknown orientations can obscure interpretation, without claiming the phenomenon was demonstrated in these data.

interp_heatmap_grid.classification: Selected historical B-scan overlays with empirical probabilities and signed slice contributions, plus unverified clinical/descriptive diagnoses.
interp_heatmap_grid.rationale: The released file is byte-identical to results/summary/heatmap_grid.png, not heatmap_grid_BC.png. Its six row labels match the assembler, including probabilities, signed slice contributions, and 'RNFL thinning visible'/'Localized pathology'. The corresponding producer scales each overlay by its own max absolute delta with interpolation; the separately retained B+C figure is the shared-scale/mean-subtracted alternative. The current caption misidentifies that transformation.
interp_heatmap_grid.limitations: The exact historical execution and per-patch arrays are unretained. Code correspondence and identity establish a documented variant discrepancy, not an independent rerun. No colorbar means no readable magnitude; normalization cannot be recovered uniquely from blended RGB pixels. Clinical labels have not been independently reviewed.
interp_heatmap_grid.unresolved_scientific_claim: Shared normalization and mean subtraction in this specific figure; broadly distributed attribution or stronger slice-than-patch agreement inferred from selected images; printed patient-level model predictions/contributions and clinical interpretations.
interp_heatmap_grid.minimal_action: Prefer omitting this grid and any main-text claim resting on it. Conditional illustration-only retention requires removing unsupported quantitative/clinical headings and describing selected historical, interpolated, per-image-normalized overlays without cross-case magnitude, disease-localization, coverage, policy-mechanism, or representativeness claims. Review the resulting exact asset and corrected caption anew; this is not approval of the current asset.

interp_slice_contribution_by_outcome.classification: Twelve outcome-mean attribution curves across three panels, with empirical accuracies and outcome counts.
interp_slice_contribution_by_outcome.rationale: Actual figure headings include accuracy percentages; legends include TP/FN/TN/FP counts. The image is not a qualitative anatomy illustration. No matching attribution/probability arrays or retained mean-series tables are available for curve or stratification validation.
interp_slice_contribution_by_outcome.limitations: Outcome labels/counts in the PNG or prose do not validate the plotted means. No uncertainty is shown. Descriptive mean-shape similarity cannot establish the anatomical cause of errors.
interp_slice_contribution_by_outcome.unresolved_scientific_claim: Errors preserve the correct anatomical pattern at lower amplitude, confidence-invariant attribution, and error-rate association with attribution amplitude.
interp_slice_contribution_by_outcome.minimal_action: Remove this result and its empirical error-pattern interpretation unless the original stratified summary arrays and threshold definition can be validated. Do not substitute frozen-policy probe data for these fine-tuned models.

interp_slice_contribution_curves.classification: Six class-mean signed attribution curves with sample counts and a native-position/subset-index axis mapping.
interp_slice_contribution_curves.rationale: Actual labels give three fine-tuned probes, glaucoma n=1466 and healthy n=1534, and a 64-slice subset relabeling of a 200-position native axis. No retained per-volume or mean-series arrays support independent verification of the visible curve values.
interp_slice_contribution_curves.limitations: Near-zero signed population means can arise from cancellation, not genuinely unused slices. A shared curve envelope is not causal anatomy evidence or validation of frozen-policy AUC rankings. The 7.14M manuscript versus 7.17M documentation counts are configuration-dependent and are not resolved or overwritten here.
interp_slice_contribution_curves.unresolved_scientific_claim: Cross-probe convergence of attribution structure, diffuse middle-volume use, and the assertion that near-zero means imply unused slices.
interp_slice_contribution_curves.minimal_action: Remove the quantitative result without recoverable series. A methods-only description can define signed delta-logit as baseline minus occluded logit and warn that a near-zero class mean does not prove nonuse. Do not relabel these empirical curves illustrative-only.
